title: Murder of 14-Year-Old Agostina Vega Ignites National Outrage, Triggers #NiUnaMenos Mobilization
detail: The rape and murder of 14-year-old Agostina Vega sparked renewed national outrage over femicide and gender-based violence in Argentina, coinciding with the 11th anniversary of the #NiUnaMenos movement (June 3–4). Between 2015 and May 2026, 3,424 people were killed in gender-based violence incidents in Argentina — 3,073 of them classified as femicides — with a woman killed approximately every 30 hours. The case drew sharp attention to the Milei government's dismantling of gender violence support infrastructure: since taking office in December 2023, Milei has defunded women's ministries, shut down the National Institute Against Discrimination (INADI), and eliminated emergency support programs for gender violence victims. Critics argued the murder demonstrated the human cost of stripping these programs. Women's organizations immediately called for mass mobilization on June 4, the NiUnaMenos anniversary.

media.caption: Argentina erupts in protest against gender violence after the murder of 14-year-old Agostina Vega

title: Santander and JPMorgan Announce $1 Billion TGS Vaca Muerta NGL Financing — Largest Private Energy Deal of 2026
detail: Banco Santander and JPMorgan announced backing for a $1 billion financing package for Transportadora de Gas del Sur's (TGS) natural gas liquids (NGL) processing project in Argentina's Vaca Muerta shale formation. The financing supports a $3 billion total investment — one of the largest single private-sector energy infrastructure deals in Argentine history. The TGS NGL project will extract and process propane, butane, and natural gasoline from Vaca Muerta's rich gas streams, enabling both domestic petrochemical feedstock supply and LNG export liquefaction. The backing from two of the world's largest investment banks — arranged on June 3 — signaled international financial confidence in Milei's RIGI investment framework and Argentina's energy sector trajectory. The project is expected to generate an estimated $2.5 billion in annual export revenue at full capacity.

media.caption: Santander and JPMorgan back $1 billion financing for TGS's Vaca Muerta NGL project
